rec.name: As Seen In / Press Logo Slider
rec.status: Built — layout bug reported (logos wrap/shift instead of sliding)

what.text: A section titled "CRO | Bekannt aus" ("As Seen In") with a centered heading and a set of logo tiles, intended as a logo slider of media or press logos. The screenshot shows the section in the theme editor with placeholder tiles and the default heading "Lorem ipsum".

why.text: Showing the logos of known publications or partners borrows their authority. This is an authority and social-proof cue that lowers perceived risk for first-time visitors. The ticket does not state this reasoning, so it is general CRO practice.

how.text: Build it as a theme section with a heading and repeatable image blocks, one per logo. Logos should sit in a single horizontal row or slider that scrolls or auto-rotates. The reported flaw is that the logos shift oddly. The screenshot shows five tiles wrapping into a row of 4 plus 1 centered orphan on desktop instead of staying in one slider row. The fix is to use a fixed single-row slider track with consistent tile sizes and no wrapping. The ticket gives no build instructions, so this is inferred from the screenshot.

items: Logo image blocks (5 placeholder tiles shown)
Slider behavior (single row, no wrapping) — inferred, not stated

dependencies.text: No metafields or apps are mentioned. Assumed to be a standalone theme section with image blocks, configured in the theme editor.

items: Click-through to collections/PDPs from the home page

images.caption: "CRO | Bekannt aus" section in the theme editor: centered heading with 5 placeholder logo tiles. This is the bug state, with tiles wrapping 4 + 1 centered instead of sliding in one row.
